rule: The bounded calculator requires exact frame alignment. Perform and document supported bridges upstream; a comparison note alone never authorizes subtraction of unequal frames.
prohibited_shortcuts: Uniform prorating between calendar and July-June budgets without service-level evidence.
Treating closure or removed mandate output as efficiency.
Converting hours to cash release without executable financial evidence.
Treating internal reimbursement as external system cost.
Treating correlated appearances or paragraphs as independent operational trials.
adjustment_requirements: Source and target units, time and populations.
Effect on required output and residual uncertainty.
